blocked.message: no "Story" sits in an open sprint of project PROJ named "Sprint 99" — a kanban/simple board has no sprints, or no sprint is started, or the sprint holds no stories. Fix on Jira: turn Sprints on (team-managed: Project settings → Features → Sprints; company-managed: a Scrum board), then start a sprint holding the stories — or re-run with --ids <KEY,KEY> to estimate named stories. See references/tracker/jira-boards.md, "Project prerequisites".

requests.body: {"jql":"project = \"PROJ\" AND issuetype = \"Story\" AND sprint in openSprints() ORDER BY key","fields":["summary","customfield_10020"],"maxResults":100}
